declarations.docstring: The auxiliary linear map from the partition-indexed carrier to the associated monoid-algebra submodule.
The underlying monoid-algebra value of the auxiliary submodule map agrees with the corresponding ambient linear map.
The auxiliary linear map into the monoid-algebra submodule is injective.
The auxiliary linear map onto the monoid-algebra submodule is surjective.
An auxiliary linear map from the partition-indexed carrier to the complex monoid algebra of permutations.
The auxiliary carrier map sends an induced-representation generator to the stated scalar multiple of an inverse permutation basis element times the auxiliary vector.
The auxiliary linear map from the carrier to the permutation monoid algebra is injective.
Every value of the auxiliary carrier map belongs to the associated monoid-algebra submodule.
After passing a tensor through the coinvariants map, the auxiliary carrier map agrees with the tensor-to-monoid-algebra map.
The composite from the monoid algebra through the auxiliary carrier is right multiplication by the auxiliary group-algebra element.
An auxiliary linear map from the complex permutation monoid algebra to the partition-indexed carrier.
The normalized map back to the auxiliary carrier is a left inverse of the carrier-to-monoid-algebra map.
The normalized map on a single permutation basis term is the stated scalar multiple of an induced-representation generator at the inverse permutation.
An induced-representation generator equals the coinvariants class of the corresponding permutation basis term tensored with its scalar.
Left multiplication of the permutation parameter by a subgroup element does not change the induced-representation generator.
An auxiliary equivalence between the two displayed complex representations.
The auxiliary carrier map intertwines the displayed permutation actions as linear maps.
The auxiliary carrier map commutes pointwise with the displayed permutation actions.
A partition-indexed linear map from the tensor product of the permutation monoid algebra with the scalars to the monoid algebra.
Composing the tensor-to-monoid-algebra map with the action of a subgroup element leaves the map unchanged.
The tensor-to-monoid-algebra map takes every tensor into the associated auxiliary submodule.
On a pure tensor, the tensor-to-monoid-algebra map is scalar multiplication of the associated auxiliary endomorphism value.
An auxiliary partition-indexed linear endomorphism of the complex monoid algebra of permutations.
Every value of the auxiliary monoid-algebra endomorphism lies in the associated submodule.
The auxiliary endomorphism is unchanged after left multiplication by the basis element of a subgroup permutation.
The auxiliary endomorphism sends a single permutation term to the inverse-permutation term multiplied by the auxiliary group-algebra element.
A linear endomorphism of the complex monoid algebra of permutations.
The linear map sends a single permutation term to the term indexed by the inverse permutation with the same coefficient.
The auxiliary monoid-algebra submodule is contained in its inverse image under each permutation action.
A complex representation of the permutation group on its monoid algebra.
The displayed representation acts by left multiplication with the monoid-algebra basis element of the permutation.
The left regular representation acts on the permutation monoid algebra by left multiplication with the corresponding basis element.
An auxiliary linear equivalence between the partition-indexed carrier and the associated monoid-algebra submodule.
The auxiliary carrier-submodule equivalence intertwines the displayed permutation representations.
Left multiplication by the basis element of a subgroup permutation fixes the auxiliary monoid-algebra element.
An auxiliary partition-indexed complex submodule of the monoid algebra of permutations.
An auxiliary linear map from the complex permutation monoid algebra to the partition-indexed carrier.
The auxiliary map sends a single permutation term to the corresponding scalar multiple of an induced-representation generator at the inverse permutation.
An auxiliary type indexed by a natural number and a partition of that number.
An auxiliary complex representation of the permutation group on the associated monoid-algebra submodule.
An auxiliary complex representation of the displayed permutation subgroup on the tensor product of the permutation monoid algebra with the scalars.
A linear equivalence from the complex permutation monoid algebra to finitely supported coefficient functions.
The coefficient linear equivalence evaluates to the monoid-algebra coefficient function.
An auxiliary complex representation of the displayed permutation subgroup on the complex numbers.
